newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse ends session 0.89 pct lower.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse ends session 0.89 pct lower.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Wednesday closed down by 0.89 percent in higher trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 461.43 points, down from 465.59 on Tuesday.
Total volume was 4.41 million dinars against 3.38 million dinars over the previous session. Over-the-counter exchanges and turnover on the occasional market amounted to 3.67 million dinars.
Coca and beer bottler SFBT dropped 2.68 dinars to 83.52 dinars with 70 shares changing hands.
Banque de Tunisie fell 1.4 dinar to 73.6. Amen Bank slid 0.9 dinar to 29.2 dinars. Arab Tunisian Bank was down 0.86 dinar to 27.86.
Palm Beach Hotels eased 0.86 dinar to 9.62 dinars. Chemical firm Al-Kimia declined 0.7 dinar to 43.3.
Banque Internationale Arabe de Tunisie edged lower 0.42 dinar to 30.5 dinars with the exchange of 3,298 shares.
Airline Tunis Air was down 0.34 dinar to 22.5 dinars with 6,897 shares changing hands. Investment fund Placement de Tunisie declined 0.33 dinar to 10.95 dinars.
BTEI bank rose 0.18 dinar to 22.18 dinars.
Trade was active on Societe Tunisienne de Banque with 10,840 shares changing hands at the unchanged price of 15.97 dinars.
